bc.continuous_loss: MSE on bounded first three outputs
bc.dataset: all eligible autonomous authored training rows, including unsuccessful trajectories; no heldout features
bc.discrete_loss: BCEWithLogits, positive class negative/positive training counts clamped1to10
bc.padding: zero loss and no hidden advancement for ended episodes
bc.selection: fixed final epoch for every seed; tuning diagnostic only

communication.aggregation: mean of self-message and received one-hop neighbor messages; root state is the only action readout
communication.message_source: current local encoded features and previous private hidden state
communication.no_message_control: identical active self-message network and parameter count; all inter-node edges disabled
communication.successive_decisions_reach: at most one further edge per decision

evaluation.cross_task_seal: do not relay T110holdout outcomes to T105before T105sixcheckpoint freeze
evaluation.holdout_opening: after all6finalcheckpoints and their hashes are frozen
evaluation.uncertainty: paired policy-seed means, all27 resamples of3seeds with replacement, percentile95 interval

memory.memory_reset_stress: clear all controller private recurrence at tick60; explicit caller goal and external task deadline remain
memory.owner: actor incarnation + profile + control/source/mount generations + goal

models.host_mechanics: unaltered authored assistance, Rapier, joints and native materials
models.shared_mapping: continuous tanh/tanh/sigmoid and Boolean0.5 thresholds; move_y0; same authored directed-hop aim; all tool/mount/reel channelszero
models.shared_primary_gate: supported true, known cooldown<=0, previous requested primary false; applied identically to authored/graph/no-message

seed_rules.paired_host: family.host_seed + 100*policy_seed_index, shared by all methods and faults
seed_rules.weights: training_seed, same initial state for graph and no-message

sensors.every_node: its own part position/velocity/rotation/angular_velocity/mass/size; explicit goal and previous requested actor command
sensors.pads: root-only sensor slots are zero with validity false; no root observation injection
sensors.population_budget: three nodes and same per-node assigned sensors for graph and no-message; authored receives the same permitted local actor view
sensors.root_only: actor grounded, energy, cooldown, ground and ceiling rays, with independent validity masks

task.success: one-time12consecutive completed ticks inside all arrival bounds

topology.physical_topology_changes: unsupported/refuse; communication masks do not modify parts/joints
topology.root_actuation: same six wire channels for the single actor

utility_gate.decision: conditional utility only if every gate passes; otherwise no-go under this fixed screen
